assessment.summary: Beta.96 source review: Aquarea 1.5.4 to 1.6.0 changes the four daily energy entities into per-fetch deltas without ENERGY device class or period_being_processed, retains monthly accumulated sensors, and changes the default/minimum consumption interval to 15 minutes. SolarPilot already rejects these changed daily sensors as period evidence; an explicit regression verifies that no interval delta becomes a daily total. Typed device polling, climate/tank and SDK semantics are unchanged. SDK 1.3.1 remains pinned and unchanged. Display caching and HA device registry migration do not grant fresh source evidence or actuator authority.
